pricing_policy.historical_snapshots: Preserve June snapshots and historical offerings unchanged. Current catalogue applies from November 29, 1982.
pricing_policy.existing_packages: Use latest dated recommendation, capped at separately purchased identical contents.
pricing_policy.new_packages: Office Professional uses the 25% contribution fallback after 25% dealer fee, capped at identical component retail sum. Other assembled quotations preserve constituent package/service prices while unpriced scope is resolved; no complete-package discount is claimed.
pricing_policy.services: Preserve quoted direct-channel service prices and entitlements; do not apply hardware dealer margins to training.
pricing_policy.availability: Known subtotals are not complete-package prices. Resolve all unpriced requirements and availability gates before accepting a complete-system order.
pricing_policy.team: Preserve $745.23 Team Edition and its explicit adoption subsidy; no automatic additional discount.
pricing_policy.support: Count base-system support and Team onboarding/support once. Optional services are additional only if outside included entitlements.

secondary_sections.name: Value and legacy systems
secondary_sections.description: Original Aurelia systems and their task variants move out of standard new-system promotion. Available for value/clearance enquiries; support continues. No manufacturing end date is implied.

secondary_sections.name: Legacy software and replacement displays
secondary_sections.description: Abacus 1, Artemis Abacus 2 and Monitor I are retained for existing installations. Abacus 2 and Pulse 1 remain current for compatible Z80 systems.

secondary_sections.name: Connect other computers
secondary_sections.description: Apple II and S-100 adapters continue to spread Logix standards. FlexiDisk and FlexiDisk II remain distinct pending format/mechanism qualification.

secondary_sections.name: Expand or repair your system
secondary_sections.description: Controllers, memory, monitors, keyboards, interfaces and hubs remain available to dealers and existing owners. Use the technical catalogue for individual specifications.
